subject: Pollination Services Inquiry for Blue Ridge Family Orchards
body_text:
Hello, 

I hope this message finds you well! I’m reaching out to discuss our pollination needs for the upcoming season at Blue Ridge Family Orchards. We’re looking at approximately 200 hives across our almond and stone fruit segments, with a schedule that spans from late February through early May.

Specifically, we’ll need 120 hives for our almond trees starting February 25 and extending through March 15. Following that, we’d like to transition to 80 hives for our peach and cherry blossoms from April 10 to May 5. Given the overlapping growing seasons, could we explore a contract that allows for flexibility between sites?

Please let me know if you can accommodate these requests and any adjustments we might need to consider. Looking forward to your prompt response so we can finalize our plans!

Best,  
Adam Russell  
Blue Ridge Family Orchards
